  mutate(regularszn = if_else(Date >= as.Date("2026-02-13"), 1, 0)) #change date

write_parquet(pitcher_data, "") #insert file

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results ='asis'}
pitcher_data <- pitcher_data %>%
  filter(regularszn == 1) %>%
  filter(PitcherTeam == "") %>%
  arrange(Date, Inning) %>%
  group_by(Date, Inning) %>%
  mutate(PAofInning = consecutive_id(Batter)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(PA_ID = paste(Date, Inning, PAofInning))

pa_outcomes <- pitcher_data %>%
  group_by(PA_ID) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  mutate(
    is_AB = ifelse(PlayResult %in% c("Single", "Double", "Triple", "HomeRun", "FieldersChoice", "Error", "Out") | KorBB == "Strikeout", 1, 0),
    is_Hit = ifelse(PlayResult %in% c("Single", "Double", "Triple", "HomeRun"), 1, 0),
    TotalBases = case_when(
      PlayResult == "Single" ~ 1,
      PlayResult == "Double" ~ 2,
      PlayResult == "Triple" ~ 3,
      PlayResult == "HomeRun" ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    is_OBP_event = ifelse(is_Hit == 1 | KorBB %in% c("Walk", "HitByPitch"), 1, 0),
    is_K = ifelse(KorBB == "Strikeout", 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(PA_ID, is_AB, is_Hit, TotalBases, is_OBP_event, is_K) %>%
  ungroup()

sequence_data <- pitcher_data %>%
  filter(PitchofPA <= 3) %>%
  arrange(Pitcher, PA_ID, PitchofPA) %>%
  group_by(Pitcher, PA_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Pitch_Sequence = paste(TaggedPitchType, collapse = " -> "),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  ungroup()
  
top_sequences <- sequence_data %>%
  left_join(pa_outcomes, by = "PA_ID") %>%
  group_by(Pitcher, Pitch_Sequence) %>%
  summarise(
    Sequence_Count = n(),
    Hits = sum(is_Hit, na.rm = TRUE),
    ABs = sum(is_AB, na.rm = TRUE),
    PAs = n(), 
    TBs = sum(TotalBases, na.rm = TRUE),
    OnBase = sum(is_OBP_event, na.rm = TRUE),
    Ks = sum(is_K, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = Sequence_Count / sum(Sequence_Count),
    BA = ifelse(ABs > 0, Hits / ABs, 0),
    OBP = ifelse(PAs > 0, OnBase / PAs, 0),
    SLG = ifelse(ABs > 0, TBs / ABs, 0),
    `K%` = ifelse(PAs > 0, Ks / PAs, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Sequence_Count), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = percent(Percent, accuracy = 0.1),
    `K%` = percent(`K%`, accuracy = 0.1),
    BA = sub("^(-?)0.", "\\1.", sprintf("%.3f", BA)),
    OBP = sub("^(-?)0.", "\\1.", sprintf("%.3f", OBP)),
    SLG = sub("^(-?)0.", "\\1.", sprintf("%.3f", SLG))
  )

pitchers <- pitcher_data %>%
  count(Pitcher, name = "Total_Pitches") %>%
  slice_max(Total_Pitches, n = 9) %>%
  pull(Pitcher)

for (p in pitchers){
  individual_data <- top_sequences %>%
    filter(Pitcher == p) %>%
    ungroup %>%
    mutate(
      Sequence_Count = as.character(Sequence_Count),
      Percent = as.character(Percent)
    ) %>%
    select(Pitch_Sequence, Sequence_Count, Percent, BA, OBP, SLG, `K%`)
  
  if (nrow(individual_data) > 0) {
    tbl <- kable(individual_data, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, 
                 col.names = c("Pitch Sequence", "Count", "Percent", "BA", "OBP", "SLG", "K%"),
                 caption = paste0("Top 5 Most Common Pitch Sequences: ",p)) %>%
      kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 9) %>%
      row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#F0F0F0") %>%
      column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
    
    print(tbl)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
